Problem: Vite path aliases need to work at runtime and in the editor
Approach: Added missing frontend/jsconfig.json mirroring vite.config.js's alias map; added /stream proxy rule for the future SSE feed
Observations: Used relative paths in jsconfig.json instead of the deprecated baseUrl: '.'; verified in the running dev server, not just that it compiles

Problem: Block protected pages from rendering when the user isn't logged in
Approach: Built withAuth(Component) HOC checking AuthContext's user, redirecting to /login otherwise; finished AuthContext (sessionStorage-backed) and apiService's authHeaders()/request() helpers
Observations: Confirmed in a real browser: empty sessionStorage always lands on /login; manually seeding the token unlocks the pages

Problem: A render-time throw unmounts the whole tree to a blank screen
Approach: Filled in withErrorBoundary's getDerivedStateFromError/componentDidCatch/render, with a role=alert fallback and a Try again button that resets the error state
Observations: Verified with a Playwright script forcing Dashboard to throw; fallback rendered correctly and Try again re-attempts the render

Problem: Need one reusable sortable/paginated table instead of one-off tables per page
Approach: Filled in DataTable.Header/Body/Pagination as a controlled compound component sharing state via context
Observations: Existing RTL test had empty TODO assertions; wrote a throwaway test with 5 real assertions to actually prove the behaviour, then deleted it (ADV125's job to keep)

Problem: Need a reusable WebSocket hook with automatic reconnect
Approach: useWebSocket keeps socket/retry counter/timer in refs; exponential backoff capped at 30s; resets retry counter on successful reopen
Observations: No real backend WS endpoint yet; verified against a local Node WS test server driven by Playwright, then removed the harness. Noted StrictMode + lazy routes double-open on mount in dev only

Problem: Need an SSE hook for the live trade feed capped at 200 rows
Approach: useTradeStream opens EventSource against /api/v1/trades/stream, prepends new trades immutably, caps at 200
Observations: No real backend SSE endpoint yet; verified against a local Node SSE test server (needed CORS header) via Playwright, then removed the harness

Problem: Search box shouldn't fire an API call per keystroke
Approach: useDebouncedSearch settles the value after a pause; also wired the actual data fetch into Trades.jsx (apiService.listTrades) since nothing else owned it
Observations: Verified with Vitest fake timers; wiring the real fetch surfaced a pre-existing backend LazyInitializationException on GET /v1/trades (tracked in day05/TICKET-ADV063.md) - frontend degrades to empty state correctly on that 500

Problem: Need infinite scroll without polling window.onscroll or recreating the observer per render
Approach: useInfiniteScroll splits the loadMore callback (kept fresh via a ref) from the IntersectionObserver (created once); cleanup disconnects it
Observations: jsdom can't run IntersectionObserver; verified with Playwright wrapping the real constructor to count create/disconnect calls. Same StrictMode double-create-on-mount caveat as ADV115

Problem: Trades page re-renders every row on any unrelated state change
Approach: New TradeRow.jsx: React.memo with a custom equality on id/status/price/onClick only
Observations: Found and fixed a real bug along the way: a literal <tr>/<td> inside DataTable's grid <div> is invalid HTML; fixed with <span style='display:contents'>. Verified render counts with a temporary counter, removed after

Problem: Dashboard recomputes portfolio value on every render
Approach: Wrapped only portfolioValue in useMemo([trades]); left matched/breaks as plain filters, matching the ticket's own guidance against over-memoising cheap calculations
Observations: Verified with a mocked stable trades reference (flat count across unrelated re-renders, +1 on real change) and manually against a live SSE test server

Problem: ADV119's memo never actually holds because onClick is a fresh arrow every render
Approach: Added useCallback-wrapped handleSelect in Trades.jsx, swapped inline row markup for <TradeRow>
Observations: Confirmed via render counters that both rows stop re-rendering on unrelated clicks once the handler identity is stable

Problem: All pages bundled eagerly; Suspense fallback was plain 'Loading…' text
Approach: Added PageSkeleton.jsx (shimmer bars) as the Suspense fallback; removed the unused .loader CSS class - lazy()/Suspense wiring itself already matched the ticket's reference
Observations: Verified against a production build; found react-router v7 skips the fallback on in-app <Link> navigation (only shows on direct URL load) - not a bug, documented for later

Problem: /trades/new needs client-side validation before hitting the network, with correctly-typed numbers
Approach: Filled in the Yup schema for every AddTrade field; kept tradeDate as a string (not yup.date()) to match the backend's LocalDate wire format; implemented api.createTrade
Observations: Verified against the real backend: empty submit fires 0 requests with 6 alerts; valid submit sends real numbers (not strings); confirmed RHF stays uncontrolled while typing

Problem: Need a light/dark toggle where React only owns which theme is active
Approach: ThemeProvider reads localStorage first, falls back to prefers-color-scheme for first-time visitors; one effect writes data-theme and persists the choice; added the toggle button
Observations: Verified with Playwright across separate browser contexts for OS light/dark defaults, plus persistence across reload

Problem: No test proves Dashboard's summary cards render correctly through the provider chain
Approach: Dashboard.test.jsx with a renderWithProviders helper (Auth/Theme/Router), role-based queries, one numeric assertion
Observations: Hit a real jsdom gap: window.matchMedia is undefined, crashing anything wrapped in ThemeProvider; fixed with a small polyfill in the shared test-setup.js

Problem: ADV119+ADV121 were implemented but never actually measured before/after
Approach: Temporarily reverted the useCallback fix, added a render counter, measured, then restored both files to their committed state
Observations: Render counts: both rows re-rendered on every click before the fix (climbing every time), zero re-renders after - confirmed both via Playwright scripted counts and the real React DevTools Profiler

Problem: GET /v1/trades throws LazyInitializationException, blocking real end-to-end testing of ADV117/119/121
Approach: Opened fix/trade-eager-fetch: switched Trade.instrument/counterparty from FetchType.LAZY to FetchType.EAGER
Observations: pshavela closed the PR without merging - correctly flagged as a quick hack for testing, not the right fix. Real fix (reading lazy relations inside the service layer's transaction) still pending from him; see tracking-progress/day08/NOTE-lazy-init-blocker-resolved.md
